item.dc:title: Nothin' But Love
item.dc:subject: Family, Comfort, Love
item.dc:description: This item is an audio recording of a song sung by a woman, with a duration of 3 minutes and 32 seconds. It holds deep personal significance as a cherished memory from before my parents' divorce, representing a time when my family felt complete and unified against the world. We played this song frequently on our way home from outings, with my dad speeding up while we sang along at the top of our lungs. The song brought warmth, love, and a sense of unity, temporarily washing away any negative energy. To this day, whenever I crave comfort and love, I sing it—and even my friends have started learning it.
